content.short: A collection of 999 evolving algorithmic on-chain beasts.
content.description:
A collection of 999 evolving algorithmic on-chain beasts. Creepy or cute, a frog, a bee or Cthulhu, Rorschach Algorithm Beasts come in various unique shapes. What do you see? Infinity-evolution:

Your NFT evolves a little bit every day, it will never look the same. Switching back to the original form is possible. Full code included in the NFTs on-chain data including a high resolution renderer up to 16K. The art generation process is documented in an open whitepaper and a free tool is available to create your own beasts.
